script:
Chen Ning's Script
Personal Profile:
Chen Ning: Accountant at Kaiyan Mountain Reservoir, an introverted and low-key young woman.
Story Guide:
[Same as detective script intro]
*The detective is definitely not the killer. You can share your information and discovered clues with the detective and cannot lie.
*When discussing the case with other players, since you're unsure who the killer is, you can selectively lie to other players, but it's best not to lie constantly, or you'll easily make others suspect you and let the real killer escape.
About the Deceased:
Secretary Wang was the investor's representative, usually arrogant and dismissive of staff like you.
Since the company took over the reservoir, Secretary Wang has been pushing you to complete the financial handover quickly, but you've been dragging it out.
Your Story:
You are the accountant at Kaiyan Mountain Reservoir. Actually, you currently handle all financial work at the reservoir alone.
This gives you many conveniences. Perhaps in many people's eyes, you're usually kind, don't talk much, appear introverted, low-key, and rigorous - just like a financial worker should be. Actually, your private life is very chaotic. During rest time, you always like seeking thrills in nightlife's bright lights and wine. You have an abnormal desire for money, which is why you found this remote and unnoticed mountain reservoir to work as an accountant. You investigated this place beforehand - due to its special terrain, whether equipment, building repair materials, or labor, there's huge profit to be made that outsiders would never imagine.
After coming here, everything was indeed as you wished. Since cashier Xiao Liu quickly left on maternity leave and no one wanted to work in this "poor remote area," you temporarily took over all financial work at the reservoir. For expensive equipment the engineer applied for, you appeared very enthusiastic in arranging application funds, but actually took kickbacks and inflated prices, earning a fortune.
Days passed like this. Six months ago, after CEO Lu Guoping of Golden Lion Group inspected here, he bought the reservoir. This place would soon be renovated into a resort, and you had to find other opportunities. Just as you prepared to make one last grab and run, the company sent the cunning and rigid Secretary Wang to oversee handover work.
Now you panicked. The reservoir's accounts originally had many unclear areas that you had glossed over. When Secretary Wang arrived, he demanded detailed handover of company financial records and assets. This guy with his cheap electronic watch didn't seem to have received many company favors - you don't know why he was so devoted to the company.
You knew the company paid a high price for the reservoir. Those financial problems you secretly concealed, if exposed, would be a mess. Actually, the company suffered losses due to your actions - wouldn't you be in deep trouble?
So you tried every way to delay the financial handover date, actually trying various methods to fill the gap. When it rains, it pours - in this crisis, you discovered the reservoir's financial gap was much larger than you imagined, especially for expensive equipment. The unaccounted content far exceeded your imagination.
Just as you were overwhelmed, Secretary Wang seemed to sense something and intensified pressure for account handover, even questioning whether you had financial problems you were hiding from them.
You nervously gave hasty explanations and temporarily stabilized Secretary Wang. He demanded you complete the financial handover by July 1st, so you prepared to secretly escape via small paths on the night of June 30th. What you didn't expect was that a rainstorm trapped you all here.
Early morning on July 1st, you avoided everyone's eyes and ears, preparing to climb the mountain road first. As soon as you went out, you saw Secretary Wang's body by the reservoir. You were both happy and shocked - happy that no one knew about the account problems anymore, shocked that if you just left like this, you might be connected to Secretary Wang's death, making it even harder to explain. After weighing pros and cons, you decided to stay and discover the truth behind Secretary Wang's death.
About Others:

Zheng Shuang: Former reservoir administrator who resigned four months ago.
Han Hongbin: A middle-aged man with glasses, the reservoir's chief engineer.
Lin Feng: A smooth-talking college student who came to intern at the reservoir three months ago, reportedly of his own volition.
Liu Gaoyang: A burly man who works as a handyman at the reservoir.

Your Key Clues (cannot be revealed proactively):

The accounts you handled all have some problems, especially current equipment inventory - there's a large funding gap.
Secretary Wang seemed to have noticed the account problems.
acts_goal:
Try not to let people discover your past accounting problems
Discover the truth behind Secretary Wang's death - if accidental, what caused it; if deliberate, who is the killer and what are their motives and methods
